# MSN Games (The Zone)

> > MSN's free online gaming platform offering instant-play browser games including Microsoft Solitaire Collection, puzzle games, and casual entertainment with no downloads required.

The Zone is MSN's gaming portal featuring a curated collection of browser-based games from Microsoft and partners. Players can access classic card games like Solitaire variants, word puzzles, mahjong, and popular casual titles directly in their browser without installation.
